description: Agent Veterinary Records: submit veterinarian license records with the signed practice records they answer to: the reading moment; each veterinarian license record with its id, license reference, the veterinarian, the license classes it states and the moments it takes effect, lapses and shows the renewal due; each license renewal entry with its id, reference, the license renewed and the moment renewed; each practice record a veterinarian signed with its id, reference, the veterinarian, the service recorded and the moment recorded. The signed report gives the signed records and the licenses behind them, each signer against the license record, each signed record against the license’s lapse date on the day recorded, each service against the license class the record states, and each renewal the record shows due against a renewal entry naming the license, and counts them, and names divergent veterinarian license records: a practice record signed by a veterinarian the license record does not list, a license date in the record already lapsed at the date of a treatment it covers, a service recorded outside the license class the record states, and a license renewal the record shows due with no later entry; then a record dated before the license covering it takes effect and a license stating no lapse date beside its veterinarian’s records, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No signed practice records, or no license records beside records that name a veterinarian, leaves those points unverified. Veterinarians match by license reference or name, with a title before the name read past, so VL-3381 and Dr. Maya Ortiz name one license, services and classes match by their words with plurals folded, a license listing no classes covers any and lapses after the day it states, and a renewal due after the reading moment waits. This reads a veterinary practice’s license file against its signed records: wever_labor-credential-check reads the licenses a worker held over the dates worked, while the veterinarian license record check reads whether every signed practice record falls inside a listed veterinarian’s license dates and class and every due renewal is on file. Verdict vet_license_record_divergent, vet_license_record_partial, vet_license_record_unverified or vet_license_record_consistent. POST /api/vet-license-record-check. Reads the veterinary practice records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it treats no animal, contacts no regulator, pharmacy or other practice and issues no license, prescription or certification, which stay with the practice, its veterinarians and its regulators, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Veterinary Records reads a veterinary practice’s own records: animal records, vaccination records, treatment records with dental procedures as treatment entries, surgery records, prescription records, lab records, veterinarian license records and controlled substance log records, each against the vaccination, treatment, visit and identity records, the rabies currency dates and booster schedule the record states, the visit, diagnosis, discharge and prescription records, the admission, anesthesia and recovery entries, the refill counts and the controlled substance log, the lab orders, the signed practice records and license classes, or the log’s own totals and inventory counts on record. The family’s ground is the paper trail behind the practice: what the animal record shows, what the treatment and surgery records support, what the license record covers, and whether the prescription records and controlled substance logs hold up; it reads records held by a veterinary practice or clinic, whatever the species, not farm production records and not human healthcare records: the Agent Agriculture Records family reads a farm’s production records, herd treatments the farm itself recorded included, and the Agent Healthcare family reads human healthcare records, while this family reads a veterinary practice’s own records and reads neither. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-veterinary-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-veterinary-records/.

records.description: Each practice record a veterinarian signed.

veterinarian.description: The veterinarian, by license reference or name.
